title: So happy to run into so many fun football loving people on my semi-demented 4th Annual Walking Tour of the Tailgates. Went the furthest I’ve ever been because TNF preseason is not a big tailgate day so I didn’t stop as much. Tho some big crews were testing their equipment for the opener. My route: Platinum, Blue, Maroon, Orange, Red, walked by Purple/Green, hung out in Yellow. Love their different personalities. Yellow Lot I ended with Shotgun 30 because of course. Highest HR: 136. It was hot hot. MVP: Yellow Lot Jello-O Shot Queen. She gave me a no alcohol raspberry electrolyte Jell-O shot + a cool neckerchief and made me sit down. The Jello-O Shot Queen makes spectacular ones. Legend. IYKYK. Starting Point: The World Famous Blue Crew. Love them like kin. If you had more fun today than me, you had a good day. I was doing pretty good with the heat until we got to that part of the journey between Orange and Yellow. Anyway, was great to see Johnny 👇 and nu and old friends. So he's just getting started. And we're going to be playing two of the best teams in our conference right out of the gates. And so, we'd like to be ready for that." My early guess: Dart plays a series or two. One of those deals where if they march down on an eight-play scoring drive, he's one and done. But if they go three-and-out, he gets another series.
summary:
Hearing Harbaugh say this, hard to imagine Jaxson Dart completely sitting out the preseason opener:

"We've got a young quarterback who's just in his second year, who didn't play a whole season even last year. So he's just getting started. And we're going to be playing two of the best teams in our conference right out of the gates. And so, we'd like to be ready for that."

My early guess: Dart plays a series or two. One of those deals where if they march down on an eight-play scoring drive, he's one and done. But if they go three-and-out, he gets another series.
